description: Ireland: exit tax on ETF purchases (lots): each lot’s 8-year deemed disposal dates, the tax due at each (41% to 2025, 38% in 2026, 35% from 2027 under Budget 2027) and the credit back when you sell. Values not given are grown at the rate you set (an assumption).

growth.description: Growth % a year for values not given (default 5, an assumption)

sold.description: Optional sale: date YYYY-MM-DD and value, EUR

values.description: Optional known values at the 1st, 2nd… 8-year dates, EUR

until.description: Show events up to this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default 20 years from today)

name: ireland_etf_exit_tax_lots
title: ireland etf exit tax lots
